name: Noreia
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Noreia may have been a goddess of the Celts on the European mainland. In Roman times she drew worship in the lands that now form Slovenia. Both Celts and Illyrians lived there. The tribe that owned her remains unknown.

attributes.attribute: worshiped in Roman times near today's Slovenia
ethnic group of the goddess is uncertain

okr.objective: Noreia was a possible continental Celtic goddess worshiped near today's Slovenia.
key_results: Noreia was a possible continental Celtic goddess.
In Roman times she was worshiped in the lands around today's Slovenia.
Both Celts and Illyrians settled that region.
It is not certain to which ethnic group she belonged.
